standing_law: Operator is the governing authority / PM. The operator selects the ACTIVE_WRITER per mission. Claude and Cursor may both code, audit, design, test, fix, review, refactor, commit, and push. No agent has permanent writer or auditor status. One writer per worktree at a time. A non-active agent must not concurrently mutate the same protected worktree.
